title: SILVER Directional Sandbox operator panel
summary: Added a compact SILVER Directional Sandbox panel to Controls UI. The panel shows active lot state, recommended_next_action, lot/action identifiers, side, qty, entry/current prices, unrealized PnL estimate, TP/repair thresholds and distances, branch states, blocking reasons, safety summary, and the watch command. Refresh summary and refresh supervisor are read-only. Guarded local TP/repair enqueue buttons only appear for TAKE_PROFIT_READY or REPAIR_READY and require explicit checkbox confirmation. No enqueue buttons are enabled for ENTRY_FILLED_WAIT, WAIT_MARKET_DATA, or STOP_AND_DIAGNOSE. No live submit, MEXC API submit, MARKET, cancel, automation_cycle_live_once, or executor changes were made.

panel_behavior.take_profit_enqueue: shown only for TAKE_PROFIT_READY and locked behind checkbox
panel_behavior.repair_enqueue: shown only for REPAIR_READY and locked behind checkbox
panel_behavior.wait_market_data: market reference unavailable warning; no enqueue enabled
